items.label: Infineon press release: Infineon and Eaton leverage silicon carbide technology to (09-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Infineon will deliver silicon carbide (SiC) power devices to

set.signal: Infineon will deliver silicon carbide (SiC) power devices to Eaton for use in Eaton's medium-voltage solid-state transformer (MVSST) 2.0 platform, designed for deployment across APAC and targeting 800 VDC AI data center power distribution architectures; the release describes MVSST 2.0 as one of the first medium-voltage SST platforms to achieve IEC certification. The two companies are exploring next-generation SST platforms based on 2.3 kV and 3.3 kV SiC power modules.

items.why: The IEC-certification claim is in the release's own narrative, not in a quote from Eaton; 'Eaton says' misattributes it
items.evidence: As one of the first medium-voltage solid-state transformer platforms to achieve IEC certification, it combines advanced silicon carbide technology with Eaton's expertise
items.reason: The IEC-certification claim is in the release's own narrative, not in a quote from Eaton; 'Eaton says' misattributes it
